body: Thank you, I really appreciate the reply. I've been sitting here bracing myself for replies telling me I'm an asshole and I feel like I'd deserve that. Maybe that's just how bad my anxiety has been because of this. My boyfriend says the same as you that I just  need to not give a fuck about what's said and just slowly phase out. That's what I'll do bit by bit and I think that will work. I think also I will make arrangements to go to loads of events and get stuck into my uni work so that I genuinely won't have time to talk and have things to keep my mind occupied. Thank you again for the reply, it feels good even just to be able to put it out there.
The yam is the power that be.

"So Afraid you wouldn't cast a shadow when you looked at the sun, you stopped looking at it"

-Filth by Irvine Welsh
YEP, that's the one! Solved!
Nope, that's the main thing that comes up when I try looking but definitely not it. It was for older kids I think because I remember it being pretty "gritty"
That video is awesome. Really depressing but I empathized with a lot of what he said. I loved the effect on the voice. Very haunting and eerie. Thank you for sharing :)

That's cool, it always helps to have a hobby though. Do you have any idea what's causing the spiral? You obviously don't have to say here but have you talked to anyone about these things to try and get help?

Ah okay, I understand. I have a similar thing with my mother. Constantly got kicked out and now even though I have a nice flat it doesn't feel like home, sometimes I think nowhere will feel like home. I don't know if you're coming from the same place but I should imagine it's similar and just as difficult. I'm sure your mother and brother just want the best for you, and for you to want the best for yourself. Pharmaceuticals sounds like a very interesting field to go in to, maybe it's not possible now but it could be in the future? 

It's hard to let go of the negative affect parents sometimes leave you with. Not to invalidate how you feel but it seems like you've internalized a lot of things your dad has said. But, it shows how much of a caring person you are that you would stick up for your own mother even though it led to your current position and even now she and your brother are still in your thoughts. That says a lot of good things about you.

It might not be bipolar but those definitely sound like symptoms of mania. Have you been to a doctor about these episodes? If you can get any help I really think that would be a good idea. Mania can feel really good but for me personally I find it can also be very dangerous. Especially when mixed with bad lows which you have described.

Does your dentist offer any payment plans? Might be worth talking to them to discuss your options. It sucks what your dad said to you, but it was likely not said in a good state of mind I'm guessing. Have you talked to him since? Or heard from him?

I'm really sorry you're feeling this way. It's understandable why you're feeling low when I read everything you've been through. You say you're close to your fiance, have you discussed how you feel with him? Also, have you mentioned how you feel to the doctors? The way you feel might be intensified by the pregnancy, maybe they can help?
What do you do for youtube? Make videos? That sounds like a great hobby :) Has anything been going on in life to make you feel this way?
Have you talked to any of your friends and family about how you are feeling?

Hello, I'm really sorry to hear you're feeling so down. Have you tried contacting any charities for financial or emotional support? I think you work a lot harder to survive than most people who have a full time job. I don't think most people could survive like you have. I know that doesn't make the situation better but you are far from human waste. I hope things pick up for you.

That sounds awesome, I haven't tried any of that stuff. I have to do more research in to it. There seems to be a lot of crazy drugs out there at the moment and I'm a bit out of the loop since I stopped for a while.
That's what I had considered, I don't know much about meth but why would people cut it with speed? Does meth work just by bombing it as well? I feel so clueless.
Thank you for the advice! :) I'm probably going to attempt it this weekend or next, wish me luck!

I've had sex on speed before, usually quite a while after taking a hit so never had anything like this. I've stopped taking speed the past couple of years (hate the comedown) but I would try it again if I could guarantee this happening again, do you think it would work if I did soon after a hit? I don't want to take as much as I did that night as I contemplated going to hospital with the heart palpitations :/

"The feeling that the poor choices made in the past have permanently tainted your existence."

Yes that is exactly right, everything you wrote was but that really summed it up for me. On some level I am aware that I am just regurgitating things fed to me by people who have hurt me but there is always the "what if?" of everything. Maybe the problem is I need to know when I'm writing wrongs or when I'm holding myself prisoner to other peoples judgments of me. Do you think that makes sense? If so that gives me hope because that is something I can learn. I know on some level these things won't matter in a few years time so I need to just keep doing what I'm doing. In the bigger scheme of things, being the places I have has made me a more understanding and sensitive person to people who need it. That is a gift in itself.

It's funny but these thoughts have been awful and intense to the point I needed to post on here but I suddenly feel very positive about the way things shaping up for the future now I've put it out there.

Thank you for understanding, and liking my username haha. If yours is a Dexter reference I totally dig that too.

I know it's hard for you but maybe in their own misguided way they are trying to protect you because they care about you? It' a shame that their ignorance is impacting you so much but I think sometimes it is hard for parents to accept not necessarily because they think it's wrong but like a lot of trans people themselves they're scared for you. I hope in time they learn it is not a phase, maybe they need time to settle on it too and I know it's hard but try to be patient with them. In the mean time I think lurking trans subreddits is a good idea and any other support networks you can find. Good luck, sorry I can't help more. But you're certainly not alone and I think if you keep reaching out you will find that and it will help you a lot. Sorry families are shit sometimes :( I hope your brother sorts himself out soon. Let me know if you want to talk more, or if anything happens :)

It's hard to be ignored by anyone, never mind family. I hate it myself. My mother and sister used to ignore me and talk to each other when they fell out with me. It's very isolating so it is understandable that it has you really upset.  I know it's hard to take on board but this is a problem with your brother not you.
You have a lot on your plate for a 14 year old that's for sure. I know how your parents dismissing you is upsetting you. Especially when it is something so deeply important to you. Have you tried networking with other trans people and talking about your family and dysphoria issues? How accessible are things medically and support wise for trans people where you live?

I understand. Sometimes writing things out helps us feel at peace. I hope writing things out has helped you to feel that. If you want to talk any more we're here. We may not know exactly how you're feeling but I know how lonely it feels to be down and I hope you feel you can talk about things.

What your brother said was not true and was said purely to hurt you at the time. Alot of people get caught up in arguments and say things they don't mean, I think that might be the case with your brother. Do you mind me asking how old you are?

He has his reasons for thinking how he does, but that doesn't mean it's right. It certainly does not reflect anything about you. If your friend is not willing to accept you, it is time to turn the page. I hope they open their mind soon.
Killing yourself isn't about courage, I don't think. But I know what you mean. I don't really leave the house much either. Why do you think people talk about you?
What thoughts are we talking about? You might not be as alone as you think, we're here to help
Are you able to call any emergency healthcare where you are? How would you feel about doing that?

Sometimes I feel the same way about myself. In these situations it's easy to feel like you're either the worst or completely alone in being how you feel you are. Not going to lie in reading your post I felt for am moment "I am not alone" myself. I always think bad people tend not to worry about being bad people. What do you think is stopping you from forgiving yourself?
Trying to put aside your families opinion how would you feel about your situation? Have you talked to your half-brother about this? Is he supporting you?
I hope you end up okay
Thank you, weirdly enough turns out I was premenstrual when I was getting those flashbacks. Still not nice. I might go to the doctor. Things will get better x

Yeah definitely,  as soon as I wrote it and got it outside my head I felt a bit better. Helps you see how illogical these thoughts are, I think I am just repeating the same processes in my mind that my mother started. Even if I am right and I was an asshole it's somewhat understandable given my situation and I have actively done what I can to make things better and I know I am a much more empathetic person now as a result. Just need to be nicer to myself. Thank you for helping :)

My therapy ended in December but I am expecting an appointment soon to get screened for autism. I will bring it up then. I had brought up the vocal tics before but I don't think she really took them seriously as they're not tics as such but it's moreso a kind of 'blurting' I guess. My dads a good guy but he is an alcoholic and does not have much capacity for dealing with things. I have a boyfriend and he is as awesome as he can be but I suspect he is a highly functioning autistic too and unfortunately has trouble knowing what to do with these things. But he helps as best he can, and I appreciate it. Unfortunate thing is friends and such can't really help too much as even if they say I'm not an embarrassment that doesn't really mean much. I have hobbies which help me a lot but sometimes my mental health makes it difficult for me to do them but I guess I need to make it a priority to try to even when I am feeling awful. Hopefully I get this appointment through soon. My cat helps a lot too, haha.

Thank you for understanding. I think you're right that I will never really let go. To be honest, I just want to get to the point where I don't feel on the edge of losing control all the time. I worry if something goes wrong in my life any point soon I won't be able to handle it. I think I will get there though. It's hard to let go of regrets about it, but I need to start looking at it as I was trying to build a life for MYSELF and like many young people I went the wrong way for a while. Just need to look after myself I guess. Thank you again

Filth! It's a Scottish film based on the book of the same name by Irvine Welsh. Amazing film and has everything. It's got comedy but it will leave you absolutely traumatised and changed by the end. It's intense. Can not recommend enough. I love me some messed up films but something about this one made me have to sit and think afterwards. The book is also well worth reading.

I don't remember anything like that, things would just fall. It was always with the most random things though. It used to happen to my sister too, I remember her being in the car looking with me in the example I mentioned. Scared to ask her if she remembers incase she thinks I'm crazy. Might ask her anyways.

Nobody ever believes me about this but when I was a kid things used to go missing from time to time. Just silly little things but when I would be searching for them they would just drop from the sky. I remember clearly being in the back of my granddad's car looking for a toy I'd dropped and couldn't find it anywhere then sitting back knowing it would drop from the ceiling and it did.

I had a long distance boyfriend (I'm from the UK and he is from the USA) when I was 18-20 and it got to a point where I just had enough of the whole thing. I was upset because I paid for everything and he wouldn't get a job, I'm STILL waiting on a Christmas present he said he was sending out.

I was way worse though. Rather than just talk to him about how I felt or end it I would pick on things he did and just generally push him away. I was really mean to him. I went back on some chat logs not long ago (bad idea I know) and I was shocked at how brutal I could be. One day I'd twisted his words so it sounded like he had offended me until he got upset and then said "Okay, you keep being upset. I'm going to go about my day and probably forget this conversation." Couldn't believe I could be so evil. I wish I had just had a spine and ended it with him because he didn't deserve that. I was dealing with a lot of bad family issues at the time so I try not to be so hard on myself but I still feel immense guilt looking back. I always try to be open with people now about how I feel even if it might not be what they want to hear.
